build.note: Offline analysis of the M433 burst clips recorded for L4047 (15 October evening); M433 spread operands as in current data/weapons.json (ADS: minimum 0.05 deg, increase 0.36 deg per shot, firing recovery 2.7 + 1.2 x delta^2.5 deg/s, not-firing 7.2 deg/s). The game was not launched.

question: Does the site's spread law (increase per shot, firing recovery between shots, one firing interval after the last shot then not-firing recovery) reproduce the in-game spread indicator through 5, 10 and 15-round automatic bursts, and what are the indicator's units?

capture.loadout: factory barrel, FMJ, standard magazine, ST Prism 5.00x, Standard then Lightened Suppressor, Bipod equipped and not deployed
capture.conditions: standing ADS, FOV 103, 27 m, 10 Mbps, 1440p, 120 fps, spread indicator on

sourceFacts.method: Outer width of the green parentheses on every frame of the 12 burst clips (52 bursts; shot frames from the HUD ammo counter, m433-bursts/shots.json). The site law (spread-ops.json, dumped from sim/core.js) integrated at 1 ms on each burst's measured shot frames and compared at the frame times; rates measured directly as least-squares slopes between shots and after the last shot. See ANALYSIS.md, section "Spread indicator against the site's spread law".

control.description: Three independent scale readings agree at 179 px per degree of spread (twice the lens scale of 89.5 px/deg): the 57 px width while side-stepping equals the site moving-ADS minimum 0.32 deg (0.318), the 9 px width at the end of a side-step equals the standing minimum 0.05 deg (0.050), and a zero-intercept linear fit of the law gives 184 px/deg.

points: Between shots the width falls at 2.68 / 2.97 / 3.62 / 4.42 deg/s at spread 0.42 / 0.70 / 0.98 / 1.26 deg (102 / 106 / 126 / 80 intervals) against 2.80 / 3.11 / 3.70 / 4.63 from 2.7 + 1.2 x delta^2.5: ratios 0.96, 0.95, 0.98, 0.96.

After the last shot the width falls at 7.13 deg/s from frame 10 on (37 bursts) against the 7.2 deg/s not-firing operand, and the handover from the firing rate is visible 8 to 10 frames (one shot interval, 8.7 frames) after the last shot in every burst.

Observed peak after each shot minus the law's post-increment spread at 179 px/deg, median over bursts, shots 1 to 15: -2, -3, -3, +4, +2, +1, +5, +4, +3, +6, +7, +6, +8, +5, +6 px (0.045 deg at most). Phase means: shots 1 to 5 -6 px, 6 to 10 +5, 11 to 15 +6.

The indicator ramps over two to three frames after each shot (43, 59, 87, 93 px) rather than stepping, so the measured jump (median 48 px, 0.27 deg) is a lower bound on the 0.36 deg increase; frame-level rms within a burst is 26 to 42 px for that reason and a 5 to 30 ms display lag does not remove it.

Freeing one operand at a time (increase, firing offset, firing coefficient, not-firing offset) gains under 3 px rms on 32; the joint fit gains 7 px by trading the scale against the rates and contradicts the direct rate measurements, so it is a fit to the ramp.
Standard and Lightened series are the same; the two loads share every spread operand on the site.
The indicator hides below about 55 px (0.3 deg) after a burst and is never drawn during semi-auto pairs (L4047).

inference: The site's spread law reproduces the M433 ADS indicator through automatic bursts: the per-shot increase, the level-dependent firing recovery (offset and delta^2.5 term within 5% at four levels), the one-interval firing segment after the last shot and the not-firing rate (within 1%). The indicator draws the spread radius at the optic's magnification (each parenthesis at spread x lens px/deg), which fixes its units. The idle state after 0.4 s is never reached in a 0.2 s tail and stays unmodelled.
unresolved: Whether the drawn radius is the radius the game samples bullets from (the indicator shows spread, not impacts); the two to three frame display ramp; the hide threshold near 0.3 deg; the idle state after 0.4 s.
siteImpact: None; the spread law is confirmed as implemented. No change proposed.

leads.title: M433 spread indicator against the site spread law: increase, firing recovery (2.7 + 1.2 x delta^2.5) and not-firing recovery (7.2 deg/s) reproduced within 5% through 5, 10 and 15-round bursts; the indicator draws the spread radius at the lens scale (179 px/deg)
leads.summary: Between-shot recovery 2.68 / 2.97 / 3.62 / 4.42 deg/s at 0.42 / 0.70 / 0.98 / 1.26 deg against 2.80 / 3.11 / 3.70 / 4.63; not-firing 7.13 against 7.2; handover one shot interval after the last shot; peaks within 0.045 deg of the law at every shot. Scale fixed by the moving (0.32) and standing (0.05) minima and the lens scale. No site change.
leads.reopenWhen: A capture that places impacts against the indicator radius, or a pause past 0.4 s to see the idle state.
